For a small farm near Coimbatore, I’d compare these three:

Option	Upfront	Recurring cost	Best for
KisanKraft 4-stroke 35–38cc	₹11,500–₹17,000	₹250–₹450/month*	Lowest total cost
STIHL FS 55, 27.2cc	₹22,553	₹350–₹600/month*	Better durability/service
Honda UMK435, 35.8cc 4-stroke	₹33,250–₹35,500	₹300–₹550/month*	Heavy, regular farm use

KisanKraft currently lists multiple petrol brush cutters around ₹10,700–₹17,000. 
KisanKraft
 STIHL's official India price for the FS 55 is ₹22,553 including GST. 
STIHL India
 Honda's UMK435 is around ₹33,800 MRP. 
RSPowerControls Pvt Ltd Honda

*Recurring estimates include petrol/oil, blades/nylon line and routine maintenance; actual cost depends heavily on usage.

My pick: KisanKraft for occasional small-farm clearing; Honda if you expect frequent, tougher use.
